info.title: BlitzAPI Reference
info.description:
Welcome to the BlitzAPI Reference.

Use this interactive documentation to explore and test every v2 endpoint. Authentication is required via the `x-api-key` header.

**Base URL**: `https://api.blitz-api.ai`

**Rate limit**: Your requests-per-second limit depends on your plan and applies per endpoint: 5 requests per second on the free trial, 10 on Start, 25 on Scale, custom on Build Your Infra. Each endpoint has its own independent budget, so different endpoints don't share the limit. It is counted per account: all API keys of your account share each endpoint's budget. Read your key's exact limit from `max_requests_per_seconds` on `GET /v2/account/key-info`.

**Null fields**: In a request body, a field set to `null` is dropped before validation, at any depth, so it reads the same as leaving the field out and its default applies. A required field set to `null` still returns `422`, and so does a `null` item in a list.

**Pricing**: Every plan opens every endpoint, within the plan's fair use policy (records per month). New accounts get 1,000 free records every month. Find Mobile & Direct Phone is not part of the trial. See [Plans & Pricing](/guide/concepts/pricing).

post.description: Find the best decision-maker at a target company using a prioritized cascade hierarchy.

cascade.description: Ordered list of search tiers (1 to 10). Tier 1 fills `max_results` first. If it finds fewer people than `max_results`, the next tier fills the slots that are left, and so on, until `max_results` is reached or no tiers are left. People already found in an earlier tier are not returned twice.

include_title.description: Job title phrases to match, OR'd together (1 to 50). All words of a phrase must be in the title, in any order, as whole words, with no stemming or synonyms. Wrap a phrase in square brackets for an exact match. See [Keyword Filters](/guide/reference/normalization/filters).

exclude_title.description: Job title phrases that disqualify a person, with the same matching rules as `include_title` (up to 50). Also checked against the LinkedIn headline when `include_headline_search` is `true`.

location.description: Where the people of this tier live (not the company headquarters), with the same fields as `people.location` on Find People. A person must match every field you set. Leave it out (or send `{}`) to search the whole world. Each list takes at most 10 values; a longer list returns 422.

city.description: Keywords searched to find the city where the person is based

include.description: Keywords to keep. A city matches when it has all the words of at least one keyword.

exclude.description: Keywords to drop. A person is removed when the city has all the words of any one keyword.

country_code.description: Country codes of the people to keep, such as `FR` or `GB`. Letter case does not matter.

continent.description: Continents where the people live. A person matches when their location is on any of them.

sales_region.description: Sales regions where the people live. `NORAM` is North America, `LATAM` Latin America, `EMEA` Europe, Middle East and Africa, `APAC` Asia-Pacific.

include_headline_search.description: When true, also matches the title phrases of this tier against the LinkedIn headline (not the About section). A person then matches when the headline or the job title matches. A headline match still needs a job at the company among the jobs that `include_active_jobs` and `include_past_jobs` select, so with `include_past_jobs: true` it can be a past job.

include_active_jobs.description: Search the current jobs of each person. The company and the title filters of this tier must hold in the same job. The matched job is returned in `experiences`, and `job_is_current` says whether it is current.

include_past_jobs.description: Also search the past jobs of each person. A person is returned once, with the matched job; a current job is preferred to a past one.

is_recent_hire.description: Only people whose job at the company started in the last 90 days, within this tier. It covers the jobs that include_active_jobs and include_past_jobs select (current jobs by default). The job must also match the title filters of this tier. A job with no start date never matches.

type.description: Exact matches for the company type search

employee_range.description: Exact matches for the employee range search

employee_count.description: Range search on the company's employee count (the `employees_on_linkedin` value that Company Search returns)

mx.description: Mail provider of the company, from the MX records of its domains. Companies with no MX data are never matched by `include` and `exclude` never drops them, unless you use `any`.

provider.description: Known mail providers, such as `google` or `microsoft`. A company matches when any of its domains uses the provider. `any` stands for every provider: in `include` it keeps companies with MX data, in `exclude` it keeps companies with no MX data. Use `include: ["any"], exclude: ["google"]` for companies with MX data that do not use Google.

last_funding_year.description: Range search for the year of the last funding round. 0 = unset, otherwise 1800 to 2026.

lead_investors.description: Keywords searched in lead investor names

hq.description: Location of the headquarters of the company

city.description: Keywords searched to find the headquarters city of the company

state.description: Keywords searched to find the headquarters state/province of the company

country_code.description: Exact matches for the country code of the headquarters

continent.description: Exact matches for the continent of the headquarters

sales_region.description: Exact matches for the sales region of the headquarters

people.description: People search criteria for company matching

job_title.description: Find at least one person with the given job title in the company. Values match as a keyword search by default; wrap a value in square brackets (`"[CEO]"`) to require an exact, case- and accent-insensitive match. See [Field normalization](/guide/reference/normalization/filters#exact-match-syntax).

include_linkedin_headline.description: Whether to include the LinkedIn headline in the job_title search

job_description.description: Find at least one person whose job description matches. It applies to the same job as the job title and company filters. Only the first 10,000 characters of a description are searched.

include.description: Phrases to match against the job description. Every word of a phrase must appear in the description, in any order. Multiple phrases are OR-ed. Unlike job_title, [brackets] give no exact match: [Sales] is searched as Sales.

exclude.description: Phrases to exclude from the job description. Every word of a phrase must appear for the job to be excluded. A job with no description is never excluded.

job_function.description: Exact matches for the job function search

job_level.description: Exact matches for the job level search

min_connections.description: Minimum number of LinkedIn connections to find

is_recent_hire.description: Only people with a job that started in the last 90 days. The job must also match the other job and company filters. A job with no start date never matches. It covers the jobs that `include_active_jobs` and `include_past_jobs` select (current jobs by default).

location.description: Location of the people to find

city.description: Keywords searched to find the city where the person is based

education.description: Education filter for the person. Phrases are matched against each education entry independently: tokens within a phrase must co-occur inside a single entry (school, degree, dates), so a phrase like "Stanford 2025" matches a person who studied at Stanford ending in 2025, not someone with separate Stanford and 2025 entries.

include.description: Phrases matched against education entries. Tokens must co-occur within a single entry, so wrap the year in the phrase (e.g. "Stanford 2025") to correlate school and year. Token order is not significant ("Stanford CS" matches "CS Stanford"). Multiple phrases are OR-ed.

exclude.description: Phrases excluded from education entries: any person with an entry matching one of these phrases is filtered out.

start_year.description: Range search for the year an education entry started. 0 = unset. Applies to the same entry as include; an entry with no start year never matches a bound.

end_year.description: Range search for the year an education entry ended (graduation year). 0 = unset. Applies to the same entry as include; an entry with no end year never matches a bound.

include_active_jobs.description: Search the current jobs of each person. The job, company and job title filters must hold in the same job. The matched job is returned in `experiences`, and `job_is_current` says whether it is current.

include_past_jobs.description: Also search the past jobs of each person. A person is returned once, with the matched job; a current job is preferred to a past one.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

cursor.description: Cursor to paginate through the results
